title: Digital India Aadhar Services Queue
scene: The display panel on the left shows 'Digital India Aadhar Services, Token # 96'. A queue of 5 people extends backward from the panel in a line, all standing upright and facing forward or toward the panel — the person nearest the panel has one hand on their hip, another holds a folder, and the rest are standing normally waiting their turn. Further to the right near the reception desk, a person wearing red is walking across the yellow floor markings — this person is not part of the queue and should not be counted. No one is on the ground or in distress.
